reviews.shade: Abib Heartleaf TECA Capsule Serum Calming Drop 50ml
reviews.text: I’ve been really enjoying the Abib Heartleaf TECA Capsule Serum Calming Drop! The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated, soothed, and refreshed, and I’ve noticed my redness looks calmer after using it. The little capsules melt into the skin easily and give an extra boost of hydration. It’s a great serum for sensitive or acne-prone skin, especially when my skin feels irritated. Definitely one I’d recommend if you’re looking for a gentle, calming serum! 🌿✨
reviews.zh: Abib 魚腥草 TECA 膠囊舒緩精華我真係用得好開心！質地輕盈，吸收得快，唔會有黏笠感。皮膚用完覺得保濕、舒緩、又清爽，用咗一陣我發覺泛紅都退咗啲。啲細細粒嘅膠囊容易就會喺皮膚上溶化，幫皮膚額外補充水分。敏感肌或者容易爆瘡嘅肌膚都啱用，特別係皮膚敏感嘅時候。如果你想要一支溫和、舒緩嘅精華，呢支真係推薦！🌿✨

reviews.shade: Abib Heartleaf TECA Capsule Serum Calming Drop 50ml
reviews.text: I have super sensitive, acne-prone skin that gets red at the slightest touch. This serum has been a total game-changer. The little TECA capsules burst upon application and absorb instantly without leaving a sticky or greasy residue. It immediately cools and calms my flare-ups, and I’ve noticed way fewer angry breakouts since I started using it. Highly recommend to anyone needing gentle barrier repair!
reviews.zh: 我皮膚超級敏感又容易爆瘡，輕輕掂到就會泛紅。呢支精華真係幫我改變咗。啲細細粒嘅 TECA 膠囊一搽就爆開，瞬間被吸收，唔會留低任何黏笠或者油膩感。泛紅敏感嘅時候一搽即刻有涼感又可以舒緩到，自從開始用咗之後，明顯少咗好多紅腫嘅瘡瘡。需要溫和修復皮膚屏障嘅人真心推薦！

reviews.shade: Abib Heartleaf TECA Capsule Serum Calming Drop 50ml
reviews.text: The consistency is somewhat watery yet thick. There is a slight cooling sensation but that goes away quickly. There’s no scent. It absorbs quickly so the skin may feel slightly dry afterwards. Not sure if i see any results.
reviews.zh: 質地有啲似水但又比較稠。有少少涼感，不過好快就散。冇香味。吸收得快，所以用完之後皮膚可能會有少少乾。唔確定有冇見到效果。

reviews.shade: Abib Heartleaf TECA Capsule Serum Calming Drop 50ml
reviews.text: I love this serum smm, the capsules don’t really absorb evenly but it’s still good. It’s cooling and Moisturizing, I love how it calms my skin down in the morning (I use it in the morning) 💕 be careful tho, for very dry skin it’s not enough, for my skin type it’s perfect but u have to see for you 🩷
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支精華，啲膠囊吸收得唔算好均勻，但整體都唔錯。涼涼地又保濕，我好鍾意朝早用佢幫我舒緩皮膚（我係朝早用嘅）💕 不過要留意，非常乾嘅肌膚單用呢支可能唔夠，我自己嘅膚質就啱啱好，但每個人情況唔同，要自己試過先知 🩷

reviews.shade: Abib Heartleaf TECA Capsule Serum Calming Drop 50ml
reviews.text: This serum is very gentle and great for sensitive or acne-prone skin. It contains heartleaf and centella (TECA) which help calm redness and irritation. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky. It also includes niacinamide to improve uneven skin tone and reduce the appearance of blemishes. After using it consistently, my skin feels more balanced and less inflamed.
reviews.zh: 呢支精華好溫和，敏感肌或者容易爆瘡嘅肌膚都好啱用。含有魚腥草同積雪草 (TECA)，可以幫助舒緩泛紅同刺激。質地輕盈，吸收得快，唔會有黏笠感。仲加入咗煙酰胺，可以改善膚色不均勻同淡化瑕疵。持續用咗一陣之後，皮膚感覺更加平衡，發炎情況都少咗。

reviews.shade: Abib Heartleaf TECA Capsule Serum Calming Drop 50ml
reviews.text: My face before and after using it, the results speak for themselves, I will never let go of this product, I really help myself a lot with acne, this product has to be yes or yes in my routine. 🥹💗
reviews.zh: 用之前同用之後嘅對比，效果就擺喺眼前，呢件產品我絕對唔會放棄，佢真係幫咗我好多，對付暗瘡真係一流，呢件產品喺我護膚程序入面係非用不可嘅。🥹💗

reviews.shade: Abib Heartleaf TECA Capsule Serum Calming Drop 50ml
reviews.text: This serum has a light, non-sticky texture that absorbs well into the skin. It feels soothing and provides a nice level of hydration, especially for sensitive or irritated skin. A solid option for those looking to calm and balance their skincare routine.
reviews.zh: 呢支精華質地輕盈唔黏笠，皮膚容易吸收。搽完有舒緩感，保濕度適中，特別適合敏感肌或者受刺激嘅皮膚。想要幫皮膚降紅、變得穩定嘅人，呢支係一個穩陣嘅選擇。

reviews.shade: Abib Heartleaf TECA Capsule Serum Calming Drop 50ml
reviews.text: This is so good! It proper calms my skin and is not irritating at all! I love using this product as it absorbs so quickly, it's amazing! Will definitely be getting more when I run out!
reviews.zh: 呢支真係超好用！真係可以幫皮膚降紅，一啲都唔刺激！佢吸收得快到不得了，勁好用！用晒之後一定會回購！
